region: Northern and north-central Viet Nam: Lao Cai, Phu Tho, Ha Noi, Ninh Binh, Thanh Hoa and Nghe An

forecastComparison: No qualifying frozen pre-event prediction has been established for this northern/north-central geography and event window. ND-001 remains ineligible because its frozen geography was the Hue-Da Nang-Quang Ngai corridor and its target window ended 16 September. Post-event warnings are not prediction credit.
coverageReason: No immutable scan ledger is present in data/, so SCANNED_BUT_NOT_FORECAST versus NOT_SCANNED/COVERAGE_FAILURE remains unverifiable.
materialChange: National 18 September reporting increased inundated homes from 16,310 to 19,183, damaged homes from 29 to 32, documented 23,992 ha of rice/vegetable crops plus 2,616 ha of other crops affected, and 8,667 people evacuated. Fatalities remain 3 in the authoritative national report. Classification is unchanged; this is a material impact update, not a duplicate event.
